_source: REV 5, Owner 7 Nov 10:05 HST: flex penalty cap at 10. All 6s -> 10, all 12s -> 10 (none existed). 2s and 4s unchanged. CB->WR=10, TE->WR=10, RB->WR=10. This is the w79 flex table.

_notes.QB: REV 4 (Owner 29 Oct): a QB may play FS only, at -10. Earlier: REV 3 QB->RB 6 and FS 6; REV 2 WR/S at -6; before that 'QB cannot flex'. Latest Owner word wins.
_notes.NICKEL: Nickel is the CB3 slot. CB->NICKEL is free because CB is its natural position group; SS/FS->NICKEL free per guide.
_notes.3-4: In a 3-4 base the slots are DE1, NT(=DT1), DE2, OLB1, ILB1, ILB2, OLB2. ILB slots use the ILB (MIKE) row; OLB slots the OLB (WILL/SAM) row.
_notes.DIME: DIME is a slot (6th DB), not a position in the 1,200-player dataset: the dataset has no 'DIME' tag, so the 4th-best CB or a flexed S/CB fills it. Plays ~10% of snaps (Owner), on 3rd/4th and long and late in games.
_notes.RB: 25 Oct guide had RB -6 S and RB->WR -4; 26 Oct guide drops RB->S and adds RB->TE -6.
_notes.REV5_CAP: Owner 7 Nov: every flex penalty is capped at 10. Values of 6 become 10; values of 12 become 10. 2s and 4s are left alone. The three named exceptions (CB->WR, TE->WR, RB->WR) are set to 10 explicitly because the Owner wants no 85+ player flexed off his natural position into WR1, DE1 or OT1 under a -10 cap.
